title: Hybrid Neural Simulation-Based Inference for Robust Applications and Limited-Budget Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2609.36044v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We develop two hybrid techniques that approach the performance of neural simulation-based inference (NSBI) analyses while substantially reducing the computational cost of inference and preserving some or all of the reliability guarantees of parametric methods. The first approach is broadly applicable, while the second is tailored to a class of particle physics analyses that admit a semi-parametric NSBI formulation.   With only a modest compromise in raw sensitivity, these methods represent an important step toward computationally efficient NSBI in offline analyses and also open the door to the exploration of trigger-level applications in the future. Based on our comparison studies, we recommend the use of our first approach, Latent Categories, for robust and efficient inference.

translated_title: 面向鲁棒应用与有限预算场景的混合神经仿真推断
translated_abstract: 我们开发了两种混合技术，这些技术能够接近神经仿真推断（NSBI）分析的性能，同时大幅降低推断的计算成本，并保留参数方法的部分或全部可靠性保证。第一种方法具有广泛的适用性，而第二种方法则专门针对一类允许采用半参数NSBI公式的粒子物理分析。在原始灵敏度仅有适度妥协的情况下，这些方法代表了向离线分析中计算高效的NSBI迈出的重要一步，并为未来探索触发级应用打开了大门。基于我们的比较研究，我们推荐使用第一种方法——潜在类别，以实现鲁棒且高效的推断。
tldr: 本文提出两种混合技术，在大幅降低计算成本并保留参数方法可靠性保证的前提下，达到接近神经仿真推断（NSBI）的性能，其中推荐使用“潜在类别”方法以实现鲁棒且高效的推断。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes two hybrid techniques that approach the performance of neural simulation-based inference (NSBI) while substantially reducing computational cost and preserving parametric reliability guarantees, recommending the "Latent Categories" approach for robust and efficient inference.
